glosses: pair (two of the same or similar items that go together)
couple (two of the same or similar items)
two equal non-collinear forces; that is a force couple in Newtonian mechanics

examples.en: I have a pair of shoes.
Could I get a few hours of sleep?

examples.text: Estuve allá un par de veces.
examples.en: I've been there a couple of times.
